name: Bones & Bounty
review:
A haunted pirate ship on six reels with 4,096 ways. Wilds and stacked respin wilds carry the base game, and the Cash Bonus Game brings persistent payers and multiplier cash symbols.

Those persistent symbols are where the 25,000x cap comes from, so the bonus is really the whole show. Very high volatility, 96.16% RTP. Expect long quiet spells between the good bits.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
